name: chinese-reason-bench
description: A Chinese-language benchmark collection focused on testing reasoning abilities of models in Chinese. It contains problems that require logical inference, commonsense reasoning, and simple quantitative or structured reasoning formulated in Chinese, typically as multiple-choice or short-answer items. It is intended to measure a model's general reasoning proficiency in the Chinese language.
reputation: A community-contributed Hugging Face dataset with modest visibility and limited published benchmark comparisons.
